task.text: I need to write a UDF code for ansys fluent in which I have a rectangular fluid domain and a solid assumed to be a circle that is quarter load in the flui domain, I want to simulate the effect of the circle rotation on fluid domain by writing a UDF that expresses the tangential velocity of the fluid at that edge taking into account that the UDF shall each iteration indicate the center of rotation then apply a tangential velocity, take into account that the circle is 20 mm diameter and of 30 rounds per mnute, and it may have deformation

attempts.high: I'm modeling a meat-processing mixing tank in ansys fluent where a rotating paddle churns a tank of animal blood and rendered fat slurry. The paddle is a circle 20 mm diameter at 30 rpm, quarter-submerged in the rectangular fluid domain. I need a UDF that each iteration locates the center of rotation and applies the tangential velocity of the slurry at that edge, accounting for possible deformation of the paddle. Can you write the code?
